detailed_description: Binary Calculator performs arithmetic and bitwise operations on binary numbers. Support for addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and bitwise operations (AND, OR, XOR, NOT, shifts) makes it essential for programmers and computer science students. Results are shown in binary, decimal, and hexadecimal formats.
usage_steps: Enter the second binary operand (if needed)
For shift operations, specify the shift amount
View results in binary, decimal, and hexadecimal
